title: BikeLab SAG Calculator: Air-Spring Pressure for MTB Suspension at Target Sag — Engine, Golden Vectors and Verifiers
description:
Calculation engine of the BikeLab SAG Calculator (bikelabstudio.com, in Spanish, English and Portuguese; internal watermark SAG_MODEL_v5.0 dated 2026-02-26), copied byte for byte from the live page, with 13 golden vectors and two verifiers: an independent Python verifier written from the documented model, and a Node.js check that runs the real engine against the vectors and against the model on 5,304 inputs.

The engine computes the air pressure of MTB forks and rear shocks at a target sag: positive air chamber with a single polytropic exponent (γ = 1.30), constant force term per model, pressure solved by bisection, leverage from 26 catalogued frames, 6 generic linkage curves or a default by discipline, over a database of 132 suspensions from 16 brands. The rider is shown a fixed band of ±5 to ±15 % by segment.

The README lists where white paper v3.0 (February 2026) describes more than the engine does: per-model γ, an independent negative chamber, Monte Carlo validation and a confidence of 72–89 % by segment are not part of the published engine.
